content.text: The indemnity package meets or exceeds the preferred position; no redline needed.

input.quote: 20.1 Vendor shall defend, indemnify, and hold harmless Customer, its Affiliates, and their directors, officers, employees, and agents from each third-party claim and resulting damages, settlements, judgments, penalties, costs, and reasonable attorneys' fees arising from an allegation that the Services or Deliverables infringe or misappropriate an intellectual property right.
input.rationale: The clause meets the preferred position in full. Section 20.1 gives an unqualified Vendor defence and indemnity for third-party IP infringement/misappropriation claims covering Customer, its Affiliates and their personnel, with no carve-outs for modifications, combinations or specifications (better than the fallback). Section 20.2 adds Vendor indemnities for breach of Applicable Law, bodily injury/property damage, unauthorised access to or disclosure of Customer Data caused by Vendor, and Vendor's gross negligence, wilful misconduct or fraud. Section 20.3 keeps our indemnity narrow — limited to unmodified Customer-supplied material used strictly as authorised and Customer's own violation of Applicable Law — with express carve-outs for Vendor Technology, modification, combination or instructions. Section 20.4 sets out standard mutual procedure (prompt notice, cooperation at the indemnifying party's expense, control of defence, prejudice-based delay standard, settlement consent), and 20.5 provides the procure/modify/replace/refund remedies with a bar on terminating unaffected Services. Section 21.3 treats indemnification obligations as Excluded Claims, so Vendor's indemnities sit outside the liability cap rather than being subject to a 3× super-cap. No deviation; nothing to redline.
